1: My truck quit on a dark road once, miles from anywhere, late at night.
2: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High
3: shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
4: I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress:
5: my God; in him will I trust.
7: A secret place is where you run when you can't fix it yourself.
8: That night I couldn't fix a thing.
9: All I could do was call on God and wait.
10: Whoever wrote this knew real danger, and still called God a fortress.
11: A fortress means trouble is outside the wall,
12: and you're still standing inside it.
13: Today, when something rattles you, say out loud: Lord, You are my refuge.
14: Father, be our refuge today, in the traffic, at the job,
15: and in the places nobody sees.
16: Cover our families, steady our hearts, and keep us under Your wing.
18: Follow Blessed Prayers so the Word finds you on the hard days.
19: Have a blessed day, and remember the Word for today.
